title: Tell us what needs to move and where it needs to go.
intro: Share the practical details your moving team needs for a useful first conversation. This is a quote request, not an instant price calculation.

reassurance.title: A useful request starts with the handoff.

points.text: We use the addresses and move type to understand access and scope.
A member of the Northline team will follow up using the contact details you provide.
No booking or final price is created by sending this form.

planning.title: Details can stay practical.
planning.body: If dates or property size are not settled yet, leave them blank and add anything useful in the notes. The team can resolve the remaining questions with you.
